title: How to Prepare for the Canadian Citizenship Test
excerpt: Study Discover Canada, practise by topic, and aim for 17 or more in mocks.
description: How to prepare for the Canadian citizenship test: what's in Discover Canada, the test format, and a simple plan to pass with confidence.
body:
The best way to prepare for the Canadian citizenship test is to study the official guide, Discover Canada, and practise with mock tests until you pass comfortably.

## The format

- 20 questions, multiple choice and true or false
- 45 minutes
- You need 15 correct answers to pass
- Usually taken online after IRCC invites you

## What to study

Discover Canada covers Canada's history, geography, economy, government, laws and symbols. Pay special attention to:

- How government works: the Prime Minister, Governor General and Members of Parliament
- Rights and responsibilities of citizens
- Facts about your own province or territory

## A simple plan

- Read one chapter of Discover Canada each day
- Practise questions on that chapter
- Take full mock tests and aim for 17 or more out of 20

Check the IRCC website for current rules. Try a free mock test below.
